description: This file defines the Permission controller class within the OpenCart admin startup namespace. Its primary function is to check user permissions for specific routes and restrict access to pages based on permission settings, optionally redirecting unauthorized users to an error page.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Controller class responsible for permission validation in the admin startup process, extending the base Engine Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the specified route; if not, redirects to a permission error page unless the route is ignored.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Checks user permissions for the current route and handles access control, returning an action object or null.
